name: GDevelop
title: GDevelop: free Construct 3 alternative
hook: Construct charges you a hundred and thirty bucks a year to make your own video games. This app does it for free.

features.say: Build 2D or 3D games on a visual editor, right on your computer.
You set the rules with simple events, like when this happens, do that.
Then publish to mobile, desktop and the web.

caption:
Construct 3 charges $129.99/year to make your own video games. GDevelop does it for free 🎮

✅ No code: build 2D and 3D games in a visual editor
✅ Set the rules with a simple event system
✅ Publish to mobile, desktop and the web
✅ Sell what you make, your games don't have to be open source

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The editor is free. GDevelop also sells optional subscriptions (Silver, Gold, Pro) for cloud builds, AI credits and higher publishing limits. $129.99/year is Construct 3's Personal license (it also has a limited free version)
